test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

12, 168, 7
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: First Number × Third Number × 2 = Second Number**

 
• 12, 168, 7 → (12 × 7) × 2 = 168

Similarly,

 
• 14, 448, 16 → (14 × 16) × 2 = 448

Hence, '**14, 448, 16**' is the correct answer.
